**The TAS this is for (required):** <!-- the game you plan to make a tool-assisted speedrun of, and what it needs from this core, system or game. A request that names no TAS is closed; open a new one when there is a TAS planned. -->

**Chimera build and core:** <!-- Help > Copy Version Info copies both; leave empty for a new core -->

**System or game:** <!-- for a game: the file name exactly as in the project; for a system: which machine -->

**What happens today:** <!-- refused at load, boots to black, message shown... -->

**For a new core or system:**
- Upstream emulator: <!-- link -->
- Does it draw without a GPU (a software renderer), or only through one?
- Is it deterministic - does the same input always produce the same machine? What does upstream say about savestates and rewinding?
